# KeybindManager

> **File:** `services/KeybindManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

KeybindManager reads the keybinds Hyprland has registered (`hyprctl binds -j`). With the Lua config every action is an opaque `__lua` dispatcher, so each bind's `description` option is the label. A "Section: Label" prefix picks the overlay section. Also the Keybinds page's editor for axiom's own binds (Hyprland.binds): a draft saved with save(), per-bind issues, presets, and recording a key combo (Hyprland is put in an empty submap meanwhile, so its binds don't swallow the keys being recorded).

### Properties

- `keybindings` (readonly var): [{ title, undescribed, binds: [{ label, combos: [{ mods: ["SUPER", "SHIFT"], keys: ["H", "←"] }], axiom, user }] }] `title` is "" for binds with no section (shown as "Other"); `undescribed` marks the…
- `count` (int): How many binds Hyprland reported
- `query` (string): The Keybinds page's search and filter chips (KeybindFilter), here so they survive the page reloading: section keys (KeybindFilter.sectionKey), modifier names, sources ("axiom" | "user")
- `sectionFilter` (var)
- `modFilter` (var)
- `sourceFilter` (var)
- `filtering` (readonly bool)
- `sectionOptions` (readonly var): The chips: [{ key, title, undescribed, count }] per section, and the modifiers the binds use, in _modifiers order
- `modOptions` (readonly var)
- `editing` (bool): The Keybinds page shows the editor instead of the list
- `editQuery` (string): The editor's search and sort ("manual" | "key" | "action" | "section"), here so they survive the page reloading.
- `editSort` (string)
- `editSectionFilter` (var): The editor's chips: sections, modifier names, and only binds with issues
- `editModFilter` (var)
- `editIssuesOnly` (bool)
- `editFiltering` (readonly bool)
- `reorderable` (readonly bool)
- `binds` (readonly var): [{ key, action, argument, description }]
- `isDirty` (readonly alias)
- `actions` (readonly var)
- `actionLabels` (readonly var)
- `actionSections` (readonly var): The action picker's categories, in tab order ("" is All).
- `actionInfo` (readonly var): [{ action, label, section, icon }], one per action, in schema order
- `keylessFirst` (bool): In the sorted views, whether binds with no key go first (after the top Add button) rather than last (after the bottom one)
- `editSectionOptions` (readonly var): The editor's chips: [{ key, title, count }] per section (actionSections order, then any others), and the modifiers its binds use
- `editModOptions` (readonly var)
- `visibleKey` (readonly string): The shown binds' indices, filtered by editQuery and the chips and sorted by editSort, joined: a string only notifies when it changes, so the rows survive edits that leave the order alone
- `visibleIndices` (readonly var)
- `issues` (readonly var): Per bind: [{ level: "error" | "warning", text }]
- `issueCount` (readonly int)
- `userConflicts` (readonly var): The binds on keys the user's Hyprland config binds too
- `canMerge` (readonly bool): Managed mode moves the user's binds into axiom instead of dropping axiom's (HyprlandConfigManager.mergeUserBinds)
- `mergeableCount` (readonly int): How many binds in user/*.lua a Merge would move (0 until looked at, when the page opens): not every bind there can (a Lua function, a shared module's, one in a submap), so it's not the conflict count
- `presets` (readonly var): [{ id, title, description, binds }], for the current workspace layout.
- `recordingIndex` (int): The bind whose key is being recorded, or -1

### Functions

- `toggleFilter(group, value)`: group: "section" | "mod" | "source", or the editor's "editSection" | "editMod"
- `clearFilters()`
- `clearEditFilters()`
- `actionIcon(action)`
- `argumentKind(action)`: What an action's free-text argument is, for its placeholder
- `needsArgument(action)`
- `argumentOptions(action)`: The choices for an action's argument, or null for free text
- `callOptions(action)`: The choices for an action's call, or null when it has none
- `callLabels(action)`: A call's label for an action (a caffeine or night light bind turns it on or off, a recording bind starts or stops it)
- `ensureLoaded()`: Loads the draft unless it holds unsaved edits (the page is rebuilt whenever the overlay reopens)
- `save()`
- `reset()`
- `addBind(bind, atTop)`: Adds a bind at the end, or at the start with atTop (the top Add button)
- `addAndRecord(bind)`: Adds `bind` at the top, then opens the Keybinds page's editor recording its key (the layouts editor's Add a keybind)
- `removeBind(index)`
- `moveBind(from, to)`
- `setField(index, field, value)`
- `removeUserConflicts()`: Removes every bind on a key the user's Hyprland config binds too (until Save, like any edit).
- `mergeUserBinds()`
- `applyPreset(id)`: Adds a preset's binds, skipping keys the list already has.
- `startRecording(index)`
- `finishRecording(combo)`
- `stopRecording()`
- `refresh()`
- `refreshSoon()`: After binds were applied at runtime, which Hyprland announces no event for
- `displayKey(key)`: A key name as shown on a keycap ("space" -> "Space", "left" -> "←")
